description: On desktop, the app's own page may sign in to an owner's own server with its password, sign out and ask whether it is signed in, through owner_login, owner_logout and owner_status (HAL-18944). The shell checks the origin (https only), the server's hello (mode owner, versions) and pins its addresses before it sends the password, and keeps the session in the keychain under a name the secret and token commands refuse. The page learns only signedIn, notSignedIn or an error code. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets none of it.
